description: Create or retrieve an offline-sandbox Stripe TEST Checkout session for funding this authenticated machine's test wallet. amount_cents is integer EUR cents (100 = EUR 1.00); the balance changes only after verified test payment, not after opening the checkout link. Reuse idempotency_key for retries; no real money is accepted.
